summary: legal checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private. Evidence: Woot API documentation confirms access mechanics but not rights to store, transform, cache, display, alert on, or monetize returned data; current terms restrict the proposed reuse. Compliance is technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Do not claim certification, ROI, or site-attributed revenue.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed. Partial evidence exists for official API documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms; no task is closable. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering source fields, provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, alert identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep outreach unsent and preserve the private gate.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, permitted storage/caching/display/alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price limits, and affiliate or advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; capture existing consent, withdrawal, GA4 property, data-sharing, retention, and jurisdiction evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and hosting data are evidence_needed; produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory covering log fields, retention, access, DPA coverage, incidents, and request procedures.

Fleet compliance, analytics, data quality, site, revenue, and launch evidence support containment-only execution. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only where site-specific consent, privacy/cookie disclosure, terms, affiliate disclosure, claims, provenance/rights, copyright/trademark, and platform-policy boundaries are evidenced. Do not add tracking, expand monetization, publish unsupported claims, or treat missing telemetry as zero. Revenue remains limited to one aggregate day with $4.92 unattributed commission and $0 site-attributed commission; ROI and margin remain unknown. Analytics has 39 configured sites with noted permission failures; data quality is yellow for analytics and aggregate revenue attribution.
